# Final screen completeness

Source of truth: `docs/implementation-status.json` (commit `2b8a332`). **58 prototype screens**, **10 overlays**, **390 interaction bindings**.

| Status | Screens |
|---|---|
| blocked | 2 |
| implemented | 50 |
| partial | 6 |

| Status | Interaction bindings |
|---|---|
| blocked | 21 |
| dev-only | 17 |
| implemented | 339 |
| partial | 13 |

`partial` and `not-started` are listed below with the reason. `dev-only` bindings are the prototype's simulation panel and are intentionally not shipped. No prototype button is shipped without an action: screens without an implementation have **no entry point** in the app.
